join.title: Join
join.subtitle: Use your personal pupil QR, or enter the room code and pupil code from your teacher. Your name comes from your pupil record in this room.

studentCode.label: Student code
studentCode.tip: Use the student code from your teacher to open the right student and continue on a new device. Forgotten your student code? Ask your teacher.

status.checkingExisting: Checking whether this device is already joined…

errors.spaceNotFound: No space found with this code. Check that the code is correct.
errors.authTimeout: Timed out while waiting for auth user.
errors.studentCodeRequired: This room requires a personal student code. Use the student link or student code from your teacher.
errors.invalidStudentCode: The student code does not match this room. Check the code or ask your teacher for a new one.
errors.teacherLimitReached: This teacher has reached the student limit for the current plan.
errors.missingSpaceId: Join succeeded, but no spaceId was returned.
errors.identityConflict: This pupil code has conflicting records. Ask your teacher for help.
errors.missingPupilName: Your teacher must register a name before this code can be used.
errors.accessRevoked: This access has been revoked. Contact your teacher.
errors.roomUnavailable: This room is archived and cannot be opened with a pupil code.

confirmation.switch: This browser is currently using {name}. Continue to change pupil.
confirmation.signOut: You will be signed out of this account in this browser and continue as a guest with the personal pupil code.

session.confirm: The next pupil must use their own code. Forgotten your student code? Ask your teacher. Answers and room access are kept.
session.logoutConfirm: You will be signed out of this browser. Your answers are kept. The next pupil must use their own pupil code or link.
session.signedOut: You are signed out. The next pupil can use their own pupil code or link. Forgotten your pupil code? Ask your teacher.
